title: Oregon Eugene-Springfield Community Sample (ESCS) Bidirectional Behavioral Matrix
citation: Goldberg, L. R. (1999, 2006) ESCS ORAIS Behavioral Act-Frequency Inventory; DeYoung, Quilty, & Peterson (2007) 10 Aspects.

behavioral_acts.text: Keep 10+ browser tabs or saved links open for an unassigned curiosity rabbit-hole
behavioral_acts.rationale: Driven by high DeYoung Intellect epistemic foraging paired with relaxed Orderliness entropy gates and phasic RT variability.

behavioral_acts.text: Read a text, compose a thoughtful reply in your head, and forget to hit send for 24h
behavioral_acts.rationale: Internal cognitive simulation satisfies the social intention before motor execution when Withdrawal vigilance and RT variability are elevated.

behavioral_acts.text: Dive into a 45-minute Wikipedia or research rabbit-hole past midnight on a random topic
behavioral_acts.rationale: High dopaminergic value of novel conceptual compression (Intellect + Night Sky chunk speed) overrides circadian routine stopping cues.

behavioral_acts.text: Leave dishes in the sink overnight when your evening cognitive battery is spent
behavioral_acts.rationale: Reflects low automatic Orderliness habit-loop enforcement coupled with evening executive depletion.

behavioral_acts.text: Write a categorized packing or prep checklist at least 24 hours before a trip
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Orderliness and Industriousness externalize prospective memory into structured checklists, reinforced by high Still Water RT steadiness.

behavioral_acts.text: Let an unexpected phone call go to voicemail and follow up by text instead
behavioral_acts.rationale: Asynchronous text preserves cognitive bandwidth for low-Enthusiasm / high-Withdrawal profiles who find unscheduled auditory demands intrusive.

behavioral_acts.text: Physically re-check a locked door, stove knob, or sent email attachment a second time
behavioral_acts.rationale: Joint elevation of BIS Uncertainty Vigilance (Withdrawal) and Orderliness error-monitoring triggers confirmatory verification loops.

behavioral_acts.text: Feel a quiet wave of relief when group evening plans are unexpectedly canceled
behavioral_acts.short_label: Wave of Relief When Plans Cancel
behavioral_acts.rationale: Classic ESCS marker of low Affiliative Reward Gain (Enthusiasm) combined with high autonomic recovery value of solitude.

behavioral_acts.text: Add extra exclamation points or 'haha' to a short text so it won't sound cold
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Compassion and Politeness actively inject prosodic warmth markers into plain text to prevent perceived interpersonal friction.

behavioral_acts.text: Reorganize a desk, shelf, or kitchen drawer when procrastinating on a heavy task
behavioral_acts.rationale: When Orderliness is higher than Industriousness under high-N task stress, the brain seeks immediate local entropy reduction.

behavioral_acts.text: Buy or bookmark new books and longform essays faster than you finish reading your stack
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Aesthetic/Perceptual Openness and Intellect treat unread books as an inspiring landscape of epistemic potential rather than a backlog.

behavioral_acts.text: Strike up an easy, unprompted conversation with a barista or stranger in line
behavioral_acts.rationale: High dopaminergic reward gain from spontaneous human affiliation (Enthusiasm + Assertiveness) with low social-evaluative inhibition.

behavioral_acts.text: Play devil's advocate in a friendly debate just to stress-test the underlying logic
behavioral_acts.rationale: Combines high Intellect structural analysis and Assertiveness with low Politeness normative friction suppression.

behavioral_acts.text: Get physical goosebumps or chills when a chord progression or film score hits perfectly
behavioral_acts.rationale: Aesthetic frisson is the canonical physiological marker of DeYoung Openness and vivid sensory-affective coupling.

behavioral_acts.text: Set 3+ staggered morning alarms spaced a few minutes apart instead of waking on one
behavioral_acts.rationale: Externalizes morning state-transition inertia via multi-step acoustic scaffolding when tonic Industriousness is low and RT variability is high.

behavioral_acts.text: Clear unread badges and notifications to zero before ending the day
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Orderliness and steady attentional gating treat lingering red notification badges as unresolved visual entropy.

behavioral_acts.text: Listen to podcasts, lectures, or audiobooks at 1.5x–2x speed to match thought pace
behavioral_acts.rationale: Fast working-memory chunking (Night Sky) and high Intellect/Assertiveness seek higher information density per second.

behavioral_acts.text: Lose track of 3+ hours in a single deep-focus block when a complex problem hooks you
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Industriousness coupled with high Intellect and fast pattern chunking locks attention into sustained monotropic flow states.

behavioral_acts.text: Keep your phone on silent or Do-Not-Disturb for most of the day to guard focus
behavioral_acts.rationale: Protects internal attentional equilibrium against unpredictable auditory interruptions in high-Withdrawal, low-Enthusiasm profiles.

behavioral_acts.text: Start a shiny new side project or doc before finishing the last one on your desk
behavioral_acts.rationale: Classic high-Openness / low-Industriousness divergence where novelty ideation outpaces routine completion.

behavioral_acts.text: Keep a mental or written note of friends' small favorite snacks, songs, or life updates
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Allostatic Resonance (Compassion) encodes interpersonal micro-details into long-term relational memory.

behavioral_acts.text: Step in first to propose a concrete plan when a group chat stalls on where to meet
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Agency/Assertiveness and Industriousness resolve social coordination ambiguity without waiting for group consensus.

behavioral_acts.text: Notice the one quiet person in a group and ask a gentle question to bring them in
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Compassion continuously monitors peripheral social inclusion and bridges group attentional gaps.

behavioral_acts.text: Maintain a dedicated 'not-dirty, not-clean' clothes chair in the corner of your room
behavioral_acts.rationale: Low Orderliness prefers pragmatic intermediate staging buffers over strict binary closet categorization.

behavioral_acts.text: Return your shopping cart or tidy your cafe table even when no one is watching
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Politeness and Orderliness uphold prosocial civic norms autonomously without requiring external surveillance.

behavioral_acts.text: Struggle to start deep work until visible counter or desk clutter is cleared away
behavioral_acts.rationale: Visual field entropy competes for peripheral attentional channels when Orderliness and sensory Volatility gain are both elevated.

behavioral_acts.text: Obsessively research the gear or mechanics of a niche hobby for weeks before trying it
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Intellect and fast structural chunking build an exhaustive taxonomy of a domain prior to physical initiation.

behavioral_acts.text: Naturally walk faster than the crowd on sidewalks and weave around slow walkers
behavioral_acts.rationale: High dopaminergic goal-drive (Assertiveness + Industriousness) manifests directly in elevated locomotor cadence.

behavioral_acts.text: Read nearly every wall plaque or liner note in a museum, exhibit, or album release
behavioral_acts.rationale: Combines high Aesthetic Openness and Intellect with sustained deliberative attentional steadiness.

behavioral_acts.text: Sketch a diagram, flowchart, or mental map to understand how a complex system works
behavioral_acts.rationale: Peak marker of Abstract Systemizing (Intellect), rapid Night Sky constellation chunking, and concept-first spatial architecture.

behavioral_acts.text: Loop the exact same song 15+ times in a row because its texture locks your focus
behavioral_acts.rationale: Uses predictable acoustic-aesthetic immersion (Openness) as a sensory cocoon to stabilize internal focus.

behavioral_acts.text: Turn off harsh overhead ceiling lights immediately in favor of warm lamps or dim light
behavioral_acts.short_label: Warm Lamps Over Harsh Big Lights
behavioral_acts.rationale: High sensory-perceptual gain (Openness + Volatility + visual imagery vividness) experiences unbuffered overhead glare as autonomic noise.

behavioral_acts.text: Sit in quiet decompression for 20+ minutes after a busy social event before speaking
behavioral_acts.rationale: Low Extraversion and elevated Withdrawal require post-event acoustic stillness to clear accumulated social-allostatic load.

behavioral_acts.text: Hold a door or elevator for someone still 15+ feet away so they don't feel shut out
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Politeness and Compassion prioritize micro-normative warmth over personal time efficiency.

behavioral_acts.text: Instantly sense a subtle shift in someone's voice tone or pacing before they mention it
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Compassion paired with Withdrawal vigilance tunes auditory processing to subtle prosodic state changes.

behavioral_acts.text: Arrive at airports, train stations, or key meetings 25+ minutes earlier than required
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Conscientiousness and Withdrawal uncertainty-aversion trade early arrival time for zero lateness variance.

behavioral_acts.text: Look up the restaurant menu and photos online before leaving home to meet friends
behavioral_acts.rationale: Pre-resolves environmental and choice uncertainty in advance so in-person cognitive load stays calm.

behavioral_acts.text: Replay a slightly awkward 10-second comment in your head hours after the meeting ends
behavioral_acts.rationale: Elevated Withdrawal and Volatility sustain post-event episodic simulation loops, amplified by high visual-episodic imagery vividness.

behavioral_acts.text: Address a disagreement or flawed assumption directly in the moment rather than hinting
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Assertiveness and Intellect coupled with low Politeness and low Withdrawal favor immediate epistemic clarity over indirect hinting.

behavioral_acts.text: Instinctively say 'sorry' first when someone else nearly bumps into you in a hallway
behavioral_acts.rationale: High Politeness and Withdrawal deploy a rapid affiliative smoothing reflex to neutralize potential interpersonal friction.
